title: B.Tech (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering
name: GLA University
description:
B.Tech (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering at GLA University has equipped me with a solid foundation in key computer science principles and practical skills essential for a Software Engineer role. My coursework and projects have provided in-depth knowledge and experience in Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Operating Systems, and Computer Networks. Additionally, I have gained hands-on experience in software engineering methodologies, full-stack web development, and cloud-based application deployment.

In pursuing this degree, I've also focused on emerging fields like Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Natural Language Processing, working on real-world projects and applying these technologies to solve practical problems. This comprehensive background has honed my skills in building efficient, scalable applications and prepared me to contribute effectively to diverse and dynamic tech environments.

title: Intermediate Education
